description: The plot illustrates how next-token prediction accuracy changes over training steps for two experimental runs, shown as two colored line series. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” appears to use a linear scale, and spans from about 0 up to roughly 60,000, with major tick labels shown at regular 10,000-step intervals (10,000, 20,000, 30,000, 40,000, 50,000, 60,000). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” uses a linear scale, and shows values from approximately 0.10 up to about 0.42, with labeled ticks at roughly 0.05 intervals (0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40). One series is a blue solid line with circular markers; it starts near 0.25 at the earliest step, rises sharply to around 0.41 at the next plotted point, and then increases gradually across subsequent steps, reaching roughly 0.42 by the highest steps shown. The other series is a teal solid line with circular markers; it begins near 0.10 at the earliest step, increases to about 0.28–0.32 over the next few points, then jumps to around 0.40 at a later point, and continues a gradual upward trend thereafter, ending near 0.41–0.42 toward the largest step values.
